title: Mitosis core re-spec (new SPEC, zero dependency on 2026-07-30)

completion_criteria.text: Scope modifications for the new SPEC are decided with the user and recorded as a decision record.
Brainstorming run in a FRESH session via superpowers:brainstorming before any SPEC drafting begins.
SPEC A (config staging/live promotion) authored standalone - no inherited decision numbers, no step-N chain, no citation of the 2026-07-30 document as authority.
User reviews SPEC A and approves it, before any SPEC B drafting begins.
SPEC B (mitosis core: token/latency cost, codegen decomposition, stacked PRs) authored standalone, with the fix pipeline excluded and no citation of the 2026-07-30 document as authority.
User reviews SPEC B and approves it.

spine.active_goal: Author SPEC A standalone: a staging/live config split whose promotion is atomic and whose sync is enforced rather than suggested.
spine.next_step: Resume superpowers:brainstorming at step 4. Three approaches were put to the user (A release dirs plus an atomic ln -sfn swap, RECOMMENDED; B git worktree per release; C converge in place); the pick is outstanding. Then step 5 design sections: the enforcement convergence check (SessionStart, Stop, mitosis Ship) and the settings.json two-way reconciliation. Read the 2026-08-06T20-05 session event first - it holds the probe measurements.
spine.last_session: Measured four facts about Claude Code 2.1.223 config symlink resolution, left the mid-session swap question auth-blocked, and proposed three promotion approaches; no pick made, no spec drafted.

open_risks.text: Instrument per-dispatch context before trusting any collapse win — the 2026-07-30 plan counts dispatches and wall-clock only, so Decompose fusion, Ship 13-to-1, and per-MSP reviews would all score as wins even if cost rose.

Re-derive every line citation from the current tree — mitosis.js is 5,515 lines against the cited 4,851, the phase-parity gate appears already landed, and mitosis-git.mjs moved to .claude/lib/git/pr.mjs.
Decide telemetry before making any cost claim — no token or tool-call accounting exists anywhere in the engine, so every re-exploration claim is unmeasurable today.

settings.json cannot ride inside an immutable release — a symlinked settings.json is followed and written through, so the release is mutated in place and anything written while it is live is stranded there when the pointer swaps

Only subtrees below the config root can be release-pointed — Claude Code writes .claude.json, backups/, projects/, sessions/ and plugins/ into whatever CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR names, so the root itself is mutable state

Whether an ln -sfn swap reaches an already-running session is still unmeasured — headless claude cannot authenticate under a scratch config dir, so the promotion-timing contract rests on an untested assumption
claude config set does not exist in 2.1.223 — a design step assuming a CLI verb writes settings.json must name a different writer, such as plugin marketplace add

key_decisions.title: Dependent MSP chains merge with merge-commit; standalone PRs keep squash
Workflow runtime forbids dynamic import, so codegen is the only path off the twinning tax
Split the re-spec into two specs, config promotion landing before the mitosis core

out_of_scope: Implementing any MSP from either SPEC
Editing mitosis.js, the parallel engine, or any live config path while a SPEC is being authored
